title: Lift an ice cube with a thread
pause_note: Shorts v4: DO + WEIRD hook (thread on a cube, frame one), timer cut, lift at 7-10 s, loop ending

beats: Lay a wet thread across an ice cube.
Sprinkle a pinch of salt on it, and wait a couple of minutes.
Now pull. No knot, no glue.
Salt melts a thin layer of ice, and melting pulls heat out of the cube.
The cube gets colder than zero. The meltwater dilutes the salt, and the cold cube freezes the water around the thread again.
With the thread inside. Try it tonight.
